prompt: What is the canonical churn rate as of 2026-09-30, split by region?
answer_text:
2 row(s).

Assumption: Region is the customer's region_code in rpt_customer_churn
Assumption: Recency measured against as_of_date 2026-09-30
Note (cav_as_of_date): Recency, churn, activity and tenure are measured against the as_of_date var (2026-09-30), the last day of loaded data, not today's date.
Note (cav_two_churn_definitions): There are two churn definitions. Customer Insights' churn_rate (canonical) is 90 days without an order, among customers who have ordered. sql: select region_code, round(cast(sum(case when is_churned then 1 else 0 end) as numeric) / nullif(sum(case when has_ordered then 1 else 0 end), 0), 4) as churn_rate from marts.rpt_customer_churn group by region_code order by region_code
